patch.value: Phase 5: the forge and the patch series

Forgejo is right that project metadata belongs inside the repository, and the kernel's lore workflow is right that a change under review is a first-class object with a lifecycle. This phase makes both native: a patch series is an object kind, review state is a record, and a served repository exposes them so agents can propose, review and land changes without a second system holding the state.

A patch series can be produced from a commit range, transferred, applied and re-derived byte-identically; review state is a record that merges per field so two reviewers never conflict; a served repository exposes refs, objects and series over the transport from Phase 3

value.text: Two of five children are complete and closed: the patch series as a native object kind, and review state as a per-field-merging record. The remaining three stay open with written specs rather than half-built: the served repository over the Phase 3 transport, cross-tenant denial without existence leakage, and publication refusing without a valid stable-FileId lock lease. The epic stays open until they land.

value.text: Audit 2026-09-13: EXISTS — patch series production from a commit range, transfer, apply, and re-derivation are implemented and tested (engine/series.ts, test/series.test.ts: 'a series produced from a commit range references the correct commits in order', 're-deriving a series from the same range produces a byte-identical object id', 'a transferred series re-derived from the same commits in a fresh store is byte-identical', 'applying a series to a fresh branch produces commits with the same trees'). Review state as a record that merges per field is implemented (engine/review.ts, test/review.test.ts: 'two reviewers writing different fields of one review record merge cleanly'). REMAINS — a served repository exposing refs, objects and series over the transport is not implemented (pm-vcs-ttc0 spec only). Cross-tenant denial without existence leakage is not implemented (pm-vcs-4ff1 spec only, no tenant code). Publication rejection without a valid stable-FileId lock lease is not implemented (pm-vcs-hre2 spec only, no lease code). Three of five acceptance criteria are not met.
